description_en: Located in the Ināy Ṭola, Madhyapur Thimi, the Bhavānīśaṅkara temple is a brick structure built in theśikharastyle, topped with a metallic finial. Above the sanctum, sculptures of Bhairava’s face are placed in all four directions. The sanctum entrance lacks atoraṇa, while inside, a stone statue of Bhavānīśaṅkara is enshrined on a lion-embellished stone throne. The deity is adorned with a stonetoraṇafeaturing Garuḍa as its central figure. Flanking Bhavānīśaṅkara are two statues representing the temple’s donors.The temple, originally built by Indrasiṃha Duvāra in 1648 CE (as recorded in the inscription dated NS 769 on the beam above the temple entrance; see 'Historical Events'), sustained damage during the 2015 CE earthquakes. It was subsequently restored with financial support from the Madhyapur Thimi Municipality and local community contributions. Following the reconstruction, the statue of Bhavānīśaṅkara was ceremoniously reinstalled in the sanctum in 2020 CE.Initially, a Karmācārya priest was appointed to conduct daily worship, supported by remuneration from the donor’s family. However, when the family ceased payments decades ago, the daily rituals were discontinued (local resident, Śreṣṭha, male, 58).
description_ne: नेसं ७६९ (सन् १६४८) मा इन्द्रसिंह दुवारले छोरा पूर्ण्णरामको नामबाट यो मन्दिर निर्माण गरेका थिए ।मध्यपुर थिमिको इनाय् टोलमा भवानीशङ्करको शिखर शैलीको मन्दिर रहेको छ । इँटा प्रयोग गरी बनाइएको यस मन्दिरमा कलशाकारको धातुको गजूर राखिएको छ । गर्भगृहभन्दा माथि चारै दिशामा भैरवका मुखाकृतिहरू राखिएका छन् । गर्भगृहभित्र प्रवेश गर्ने ढोकामाथि तोरण राखिएको छैन । गर्भगृहभित्र सिंह अङ्कत ढुङ्गाको आसनमाथि भवानीशङ्कर (शिव र पार्वती) को ढुङ्गाको मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । भवानीशङ्करलाई गरुड अङ्कित ढुङ्गाको तोरण चढाइएको छ । भवानीशङ्करको दायाँबायाँ दाताका परिवारहरू भएका दुईवटा मूर्ति राखिएका छन् ।इन्द्रसिंह दुवारले छोरा पूर्ण्णरामको नामबाट नेसं ७६९ (सन् १६४८) मा यो मन्दिर निर्माण गरेका थिए । विसं २०७२ (सन् २०१५) को भूकम्पले मन्दिरमा क्षति पुगेको थियो । मध्यपुर थिमि नगरपालिकाबाट प्राप्त आर्थिक सहयोग र स्थानीयहरूसँग चन्दा उठाएर मन्दिरको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । पुनर्निर्माण सम्पन्न भएपछि विसं २०७७ असार ११ गते (सन् २०२०) मा भवानीशङ्करको मूर्तिलाई विधिवत् रूपले मन्दिरको गर्भगृहभित्र स्थापना गरिएको थियो ।यस मन्दिरमा कर्मचार्यलाई पुजारीको रूपमा नियुक्त गरिएको थियो । उनले मन्दिरमा नित्यपूजा गरेवापत् दाताको परिवारले केही पारिश्रमिक दिने गरेको थियो । पछि दाताको परिवारले पारिश्रमिक दिन बन्द गरेपछि दशकौंअघि नै नित्यपूजा बन्द भइसकेको थियो (Local resident from a Śreṣṭha caste, male, age 58) ।

historical_events.event_description: Indrasiṃha Duvāra constructed the Bhavānīśaṅkara temple in honor of his son, Purṇṇarāma.

The inscription on the pillar is partially eroded, making it unclear for what specific purpose it was originally installed. However, it can be inferred that the pillar was erected to mark a boundary. A warning is inscribed stating that if anyone damages the pillar, they will incur the sin of the five great offenses (pañcamahāpāpa), equivalent to the sin of defiling the sacred Cā̃gunārāyaṇa. According to locals, this pillar does not originally belong to the Bhavānīśaṅkara temple but was brought from somewhere else and placed in the temple's southwest corner.

historical_events.event_name: Reconstruction after the earthquake of 2015 CE
historical_events.event_description: The metal-plate inscription records that following the damage caused by the 2015 CE earthquake, a committee was formed to oversee the reconstruction of the temple. The reconstruction work was inaugurated in 2016 CE (VS 2073, on the 14th day of the month), and the temple was reconsecrated in 2020 CE (VS 2077, on the 11th day of the month of Āṣāḍha). The inscription also lists the institutions and individuals who contributed donations toward the reconstruction.
